message_text: Status on the sync near Kapurthala Police Station?
Moving the usual amount tonight. Same place.
Keep it clean. Kolkata FMCG net is watching.
Understood. Package leaves at midnight.
Got the update on the mentorship sync. Ready.
Good. Same place as before?
Too open. Near the Lotus Temple is better.
Fine. Bring the usual amount.
Package is secured. See you at six.
Hey Ritu! Are you ready for Diwali next week?
Almost! Just need to buy sweets and some fairy lights.
Get some kaju katli from Haldirams if you can. Also, remember that file packet you asked about?
Oh yes, did you manage to get it sorted out?
Yes, Ghost handed the documents over near the Supreme Court of India yesterday evening.
Perfect. That saves so much hassle before the holiday rush.
Totally. Let's catch up properly over chai this weekend!
Package ready?
Usual amount. Same place as before.
Before the regional session starts?
Keep it quiet. Near Park Street Dining Restaurant.
Understood. See you.
Hey Juhi! Happy Diwali in advance. Are you in town this weekend?
Hey Prem! Yes, I am. Just prepping some sweets with family. You?
Same here. Oh by the way, I might drop by the Andheri Logistics Warehouse Hub later to drop off a parcel for Ghost.
Ah got it. Well, let's catch up over some chai once you are done!
The consignment from Hyderabad Pharma Logistics Consortium is ready.
Same parameters as before?
The usual amount. Nothing changed.
Understood. Is the package secured?
Sealed. Meet near Majestic Bus Transport Hub in twenty.
Keep your phone off until then.
Did the package arrive from the Pune vendor yet?
Just got the usual amount. Same place as before?
Lotus Temple side works. Keep it brief.
Understood. See you at ten.
Did the usual amount clear?
Just checked. Yes, it did.
Good. Make sure the Kochi logistics file is encrypted properly before forwarding.
Already handled. Same protocol as last time.
Let us review the package near MTR Restaurant Express this evening.
Too crowded there. Let us find a quieter spot.
Fine. Ping me when you leave.
Are we still on for the coordination meeting near Lajpat Nagar Central Market?
Yeah, same place as before. Bring the usual amount.
Got it. The package is locked in. Let's keep it brief.
Agreed. Don't want any eyes on us this time.
Hey Gaurav, are you free this weekend? Thinking of ordering some biryani from that new place.
Hi Konkana! I am totally free. My mom was actually asking if we have plans for Diwali shopping yet.
Oh true, Diwali is just around the corner! We should definitely go to the local market together on Saturday.
Saturday works great for me. My sister also wants to join us if that is okay with you.
The more the merrier! Let us finalize the time tomorrow. See you!
Hey! Are we still on for momos this evening at the usual spot?
Yes absolutely! I am craving them so much since morning.
Awesome. Also, my mom is making extra Diwali sweets, she asked me to pack some for you.
Oh please do! Aunty makes the best laddoos ever.
True that. I will see you at 6 pm sharp then.
Done, see you in a bit!
Bro, are you free this weekend? Thinking of heading to the local food street.
Yeah, absolutely! Saturday evening works best for me. Let's try that new dosa place.
Done. Also, my mom was asking if your parents are visiting us for Diwali next month.
Not sure yet, dad has some office work, but mom really wants to travel.
Ah, okay. Hope they can make it, it has been ages since we all celebrated together.
True that! Anyway, see you on Saturday. Don't be late like last time.
Hey Vimala, are you free this weekend? Thinking of checking out that new dosa place.
Hey Raghav! Saturday works for me. My brother told me their butter masala dosa is amazing.
Awesome, let us plan for Saturday evening then. By the way, did your mom start making sweets for Diwali yet?
Not yet, she is planning to buy the ingredients tomorrow morning. The whole house is going to smell like besan ladoos soon!
Nice! Save some for me. See you on Saturday at six.
Hey Durga! Are you guys making modaks at home this Ganesh Chaturthi?
Yes Sai, Mom is already prepping the rice flour and coconut filling since morning!
Oh nice! Save some for me please. Also, are we still meeting for filter coffee this Sunday?
Definitely, Sunday evening works best for me. Let us try that new South Indian place near the station.
Perfect, heard their idlis are super soft. See you then!
Hey Vivek, are we still on for momos this evening?
Hey Aditi! Yes absolutely, Sharma uncle's stall near the park?
Perfect. Also, my mom is making kheer for Diwali tomorrow, she said you have to come grab some.
Oh man, aunty's kheer is the best! I will definitely drop by in the afternoon.
Awesome. Have you bought any firecrackers yet or just lights?
Just fairy lights and diyas this time. Trying to keep it peaceful and eco-friendly.
Good call. See you at 6 PM at the momo stall then!
